what: validation evaluation of Isogon challenger models fitted on SPLIT.md fitting fires and scored once on SPLIT.md validation fires under protocol version 3

blind_test_protocol.name: sealed hidden rows, schedule from the pass list, empty passes scored
blind_test_protocol.rule: with an instrument hidden, the window, the estimate, the declared cells, the intervals, the belief frames, the exports and an agent's observation are built from the visible rows only; the hidden rows are opened by the scorer alone, after every prediction is fixed
blind_test_protocol.replaces: version 2, in which predictions were published at nominal half-day slots with a typical pixel size and only hidden overpasses that left a detection were scored

chosen_default_challenger.selection_rule: chosen on SPLIT.md validation fires by lexicographic order: (1) most scores ahead of both baselines under 2000-fire bootstrap at 0.90, (2) fewest scores behind either baseline, (3) most scores ahead of reconstruction directly, (4) highest mean of strict 375 m CSI and 1-cell tolerant CSI

fitting_summary.description: SPLIT.md fresh_world_v1 fitting set only (300 fires, 5050 VIIRS CMR looks)

painted_modis.label: MODIS detections painted onto the cells they cover (nearest overpass in time, within 12 h)

overlap_ratio.label: painted MODIS cells; pixel count = calendar overlap ratio 6.552 times (nearest Terra + nearest Aqua pixels); FRP times one overlap ratio 0.814 (from 2685 pairs: real FIRMS rows of plumas_ca, lytton_bc, evia_greece context boxes, years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021, with the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/training.py)); FRP interval from the 5th to 95th percentile of pair ratios

reconstruction.label: occupancy filter on the 375 m grid from the visible instrument only; parameters: 22 real fire episodes of 2018, 2019, 2020, 2022, 2023, 2021 in the plumas_ca, lytton_bc and evia_greece context boxes, the three 2021 test fires excluded (backend/model/episodes.py)

challenger_logistic.label: regularized logistic regression with monotone transforms and physics interactions from visible MODIS only; fitted on SPLIT.md fitting fires

challenger_mlp.label: two-layer SiLU residual neural network with linear skip from visible MODIS only; fitted on SPLIT.md fitting fires

challenger_gbdt.label: histogram gradient boosted decision trees with GOSS sampling from visible MODIS only; fitted on SPLIT.md fitting fires

challenger_blend.label: out-of-fold log-odds stack of logistic regression, residual MLP, and histogram GBDT from visible MODIS only; fitted on SPLIT.md fitting fires
